title: Creating Multifaceted Protagonists: Crafting Internal and External Conflict
use_cases: Use when developing complex character motivations and backstories for screenplays
Implement when transitioning a protagonist's internal flaws into external narrative obstacles
Configure when seeking automated feedback via checklist tools for script breakthroughs
Use when evaluating character development consistency across multiple drafts
content:
At Greenlight Coverage, we know the scripts producers and execs remember fuse messy internal battles with high-stakes external conflict. We see where scripts fall flat—uncertain motivation, thin obstacles, or shallow change. Our reports cut to the core of your protagonist, layering feedback on every blind spot, flaw, and friction point.

Review your protagonist’s motivation, backstory, and growth at every draft. Flip strengths into flaws. Challenge values. Don’t let change come easy.

If you’re stuck, use our checklist tools and targeted questions for instant breakthroughs. Our software gives actionable feedback in minutes, showing you exactly where and how to push each character forward. That means faster drafts, sharper notes, and screenplays that stand out.
